purpose: Falsify or recover local context-by-checkpoint identity geometry after the pooled global between-class object passed and the two-replica local object failed.
claim_boundary: This is a development-model geometry experiment. It may establish local lineage, cycle availability, and noise-valid discrete holonomy on the frozen Qwen3.5-0.8B grid. It cannot establish semantic identity, causal edit value, VPD efficacy, capability preservation, compactification, recursive improvement, or RSI.
state_axis_interpretation: Engineering checkpoint axis only; the naive adapter is not an efficacy comparator.

capture.activation_object: first tensor in residual-block output at the final non-padding prompt token

primary_object.common_rank_rule: For each site x family cell, choose the largest rank passing at every state x context node. No passing common rank stops that cell before graph construction.

holonomy.construction_validation_agreement: determinant component agrees and maximum-angle difference is at most max(1 degree, matched-noise upper 95)
holonomy.noise_valid: validation maximum canonical angle exceeds the matched flat-estimation-noise upper 95

aggregate_gate.causal_outer_opens_only_if: At least one orientation-preserving loop is admitted, construction/validation-stable, and above its noise floor, while the aggregate site/family gate passes.

qwen17_confirmation: Blocked unless the development run opens the frozen causal outer stage and that causal stage passes its preregistered incremental-prediction and directional-dose gates.
